The Quetta Gladiators–Peshawar Zalmi rivalry is a cricket rivalry between two teams in the Pakistan Super League (PSL), a rivalry between the cricket teams of Quetta and Peshawar that has intensified in the PSL. This rivalry is considered important due to how closely contested it has been in terms of results, particularly in the earlier seasons of the PSL.
Both teams have played on 28 occasions against each other, with Peshawar Zalmi winning 15 of them. In the 2016 season, both teams won a group stage game each, with Quetta narrowly winning the season's third encounter in the qualifier. In the 2017 season, Zalmi won the second of the group stage matches after the first was washed out, but Quetta once again narrowly won the teams' next match in the qualifier. The sides once again met for a fourth time in the season in the 2017 PSL final; this time Peshawar emerged triumphant to win their maiden PSL title. In the 2018 season, the Gladiators and Zalmi both won a group stage game apiece; the teams once again met in a post-group stage match, this time in the eliminator, where Peshawar clinched a 1-run win, the same winning margin between the sides in the knockout rounds for the third successive time. In the 2019 season, the Gladiators completed the group stage double over Zalmi, before defeating them twice more in the qualifier and in the 2019 PSL final to win their first PSL title. In the following 4 seasons, Zalmi dominated this fixture, going on a 7-game winning streak against Quetta. They  completed the group stage double over the Gladiators in the 2020, 2021 and 2022 seasons, continuing their streak by winning the sides' first encounter in the 2023 season. Quetta finally ended their winless run against Peshawar by defeating them in their second clash in that season and in the first match between the sides in the 2024 season. Nevertheless, Zalmi won the return fixture in that season. In the 2025 season, Quetta did the group stage double over Zalmi, but Peshawar struck back in the 2026 season to achieve their fourth double over the Gladiators.
